title: NoThanksPack
description: Gain control over server resource packs. Disable them easily without being kicked.
body:
# Stop forced server resource packs!
**NoThanksPack** is a lightweight Fabric mod that gives you the freedom to choose which resource packs you want to use. No more forced server textures that ruin your FPS or your carefully picked aesthetic.

Features:
- 🔓 Unlock Server Packs: Adds the "disable" arrow to server resource packs in the settings menu, which are normally locked.
- 🤫 Server Spoofing: The server will think you still have the pack enabled. You won't be kicked, even if the pack is "required".
- 💾 Persistent Choices: Remembers which server packs you've disabled, so you don't have to do it every time you log in.
